title: Guest Wi-Fi drops the connection every 5-10 minutes
description: Guest users connect to the Guest Wi-Fi, but it drops automatically at certain intervals. Three different people complained about it today.

worklogs.description: DHCP pool usage was checked — about 90% of the quota appears to be in use.
A temporary workaround of shortening the lease time was passed on to the network team.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The DHCP lease time was lowered from 1 hour to 30 minutes; I'm monitoring it.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: The customer was again able to stay connected for 5 minutes before dropping.
